answer: Reaching the inlet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The wharf is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the tundra. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, re-queued for a second panel, rewards vest against future work.
